svg.text: Make two the same. Inside 210 wide, 845 long to the lip, sides 280 high

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Floor 735 long; back slopes 110 so it rides over mud going back

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lip 8 x 50 bar set at 20 degrees, bevelled to the floor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two skids 8 x 25 under the floor, 160 apart, rear ends cut at 45 deg

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four bridle lugs 10 mm, 19 mm holes 75 up: two at the front, two at the rear

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tipping bar socket 33.7 x 150 at 45 deg on the back; one bar 26.9 x 900 loose

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 258 over the shackle pins, so two boxes pass 42 apart on lines 300 apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 40 L of water to a 245 mm level fits; sits flat on its skids
